title: Drift Away Suite Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Say hello to Drift Away 1 on quaint Savannah Street in picturesque Seaside. The house was completely remodeled top to bottom in 2017, so won't you be lucky to choose this as your new favorite vacation home! Bright and cheery coastal decor welcomes you in every sunny space.
description_expanded: Description* Construction Notice - Third-party construction is occurring on an adjacent lot across from this residence and may be visible or audible during permitted hours. In Seaside, Florida, construction hours are Monday–Saturday, 8 AM–6 PM. Please contact the Homeowner’s Collection team at 1-855-411-1557 to inquire on construction details.117 SAVANNAH STREET1 KING BED, 1 QUEEN SLEEPER SOFA. (updated to king bed Jan. 2024, new pics to come)Welcome to Drift Away Suite in Seaside, FloridaTucked away on charming Savannah Street, Drift Away Suite is a beautifully remodeled one-bedroom lock-off retreat offering comfort, privacy, and an unbeatable location in the heart of Seaside, Florida. Just a short stroll from the private beach access, swimming pools, tennis courts, fitness center, and children’s park, this inviting suite is ideal for couples or small families seeking a walkable coastal escape.Private Entrance & Screened Porch LivingGuests enter through a separate rear entrance, creating a quiet and private experience. The screened-in porch welcomes you with rocking chairs—an ideal spot for morning coffee, evening breezes, or unwinding after a day at the beach. This cozy outdoor space sets the tone for a relaxed Seaside stay.Bright Open-Concept Living & Renovated KitchenInside, the suite features a light-filled open floor plan combining living, dining, and kitchen spaces. Cheerful coastal décor and thoughtful updates make the home feel fresh and inviting. The fully renovated kitchen includes bar seating for three, a full-size refrigerator, microwave, dishwasher, coffee maker, and a four-burner electric stove—perfect for easy meals or casual nights in.Comfortable Living Area with Extra Sleeping SpaceThe living area is designed for comfort, featuring a queen sleeper sofa to accommodate additional guests and a large wall-mounted flat-screen TV for movie nights or relaxing evenings indoors.Serene King Bedroom & Spa-Inspired BathThe king bedroom is tucked just off the main living space and is filled with natural light, offering a peaceful place to unwind. The bedroom shares a fully renovated hall bathroom with the living area, featuring a single vanity and a glass-enclosed walk-in shower with modern finishes.Ideal for Groups When Combined with Drift Away MainFor larger gatherings, Drift Away Suite can be reserved alongside Drift Away Main, creating a flexible compound that comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests—perfect for extended families or friends traveling together. Please note that all Drift Away properties share a washer and dryer, conveniently located nearby.Parking is available in a shared driveway for this unit. If Drift Away Main and Drift Away Suite are rented together, guests will have first-come, first-served access to the driveway. Additionally, a Seaside Town Council parking pass will be provided for self-parking along Savannah Street, as long as no driveways are blocked, as well as overflow parking at Smolian Circle.* 3 night minimum Spring, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. (Not available for Summer, Spring Break or Fall Break). Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURESSeaside Private Residential Beach at Savannah PavilionDrift Away Suite (Lock-Off Unit) separate living quarters within the same home, connected by an interior door to Drift Away Main. Drift Away Suite and Drift Away Main may be rented together and share a driveway and washer and dryer176 yards to beach access approximately a 3-minute walkPeacock Alley Linens fresh and luxurious towels and sheets throughout the homeShared washer and dryerAccess to amenities including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedParking 1 parking pass issued for one-bedroom homes. Golf carts are considered vehicles and are prohibited for non-homeowners. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowed
